plan.cold_definition: New workload-specific base-model volume. New process; architecture-specific pinned image/kernel caches are not cleared.
plan.warm_definition: New adapter/optimizer/process, same seed, reuse only that workload base-model volume.
plan.quality_protocol: Dedicated ready observer per GPU evaluates each published checkpoint during the campaign; checkpoint target time is receipt of successful held-out evaluation, including publication/download/evaluation delays. Observer startup and idle compute are separately charged experiment overhead. No pre-target checkpoint interpolation.
plan.serving_protocol: Cross-GPU comparison uses exactly the same two H100 warm final adapter artifacts on both GPUs; local GPU request streams, not hosted tenants. Three counterbalanced repetitions of isolated/mixed waves at global concurrency 1,8,16. Original lookup/sum environment extended to 32 tool turns + final answer, 16 episodes.
plan.scope: Matched hardware plus qualified architecture-specific image comparison, not a code change speedup. One seed with cold/warm repeats, 128 train /128 disjoint held-out custom MMLU-Pro other questions. A quality target may remain unreached. Actual receipt attribution is per owned app; customer charge is separate unknown.

recovery_plan.reason: Original persistent evaluators exhausted the bounded lifetime after provisioning delays. All eight training jobs succeeded; two B200 SFT warm checkpoint grades were missing, B200 serving completed but H100 serving was interrupted by supervisor cleanup. Retain original failures and repeat serving on both GPUs at the same barrier for a matched comparison.
recovery_plan.changes: Isolated namespace and fixed campaign instead of polling training; durable outputs after each serving wave and episode pair; same model, adapters, grader, generation settings, serving matrix and episodes. B200 missing grades are explicitly post-job recovery measurements.
recovery_plan.upper_bound_method: Completed training end-to-end wall time at maximum GPU/CPU/RAM reservation rate (also conservatively covers CPU-only publication) + full original 3600-second evaluator allocations + two 1500-second recovery allocations; 1.75x region premium. Separate storage/egress allowance remains $2.

recovery_schedule_amendment.reason: H100 remains pending provider capacity while B200 is prepared. Release the common serving signal now so B200 avoids further idle cost and its fixed lifetime can complete useful work. H100 uses the same signal on readiness. Hardware requests run on independent GPUs; no cross-GPU synchronization is required for matched-input comparison.

recovery_stop.reason: No completed wave for over five minutes after eight successful waves; diagnostic shows live process, 100% GPU utilization and approximately 120 W. Stop owned evaluator to avoid further idle/stalled spend. Root cause is not established. No further retry.

cost.note: Current-day accrued provider metering, not a finalized invoice. Region premium included by provider. Empty/missing receipts are unknown. Each training run and each persistent evaluator owns its app. Evaluator cost is experiment overhead, not silently assigned to training.
cost.customer_charge_note: Direct operator workload; customer charge ledger unavailable.

limitations: Original evaluator timeout retained; B200 SFT warm grades were recovered post-job; serving was repeated on both GPUs with durable per-wave output. H100 stalled after 8/18 waves and was stopped; no H100 recovery agent episode completed. B200 completed all work.
One training seed; cold/warm are separate cache conditions, not independent seed replications.
Hardware and qualified architecture-specific image change together. BF16 kernels/backend selection can differ.
The custom MMLU-Pro other split is not an official benchmark score.
Persistent observers are benchmark infrastructure. Their startup/idle cost is retained separately from the training app receipts.
Serving timings exclude hosted HTTP, authorization, routing and real customer isolation. Queue-inclusive and local admitted request latency are separate.
Long agents are 33-turn inference episodes, not long-agent RL training.

Native timers are overlapping component totals, not a complete exclusive timeline. Liveness samples only bound some publication time; SFT optimizer-only and checkpoint-capture durations remain unmeasured.
Current provider receipts are accrued and provisional; missing/finalized customer billing remains unknown.
Direct provider campaign does not qualify hosted preparation/collection hooks.
